  "content": "import { readClientMessage, type ClientMessage, type ServerMessage, type WorldSync } from \"./protocol\";\n\n/**\n * Frame encoding. v1: JSON text frames for everything except the join\n * world-sync, which is one gzipped binary frame (a fresh world's block diff\n * is tiny, but a terraformed one isn't — and block diffs gzip extremely\n * well). Both runtimes are covered: Bun's native zlib on the server,\n * CompressionStream/DecompressionStream in the browser.\n */\n\nexport function encodeServerMessage(message: ServerMessage): string {\n  return JSON.stringify(message);\n}\n\nexport function encodeClientMessage(message: ClientMessage): string {\n  return JSON.stringify(message);\n}\n\n/** Parses + validates one client text frame; null for binary/garbage/off-spec. */\nexport function decodeClientFrame(data: unknown): ClientMessage | null {\n  if (typeof data !== \"string\") return null;\n  try {\n    return readClientMessage(JSON.parse(data));\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\n/** Parses one server text frame (the client trusts its server; shape only). */\nexport function decodeServerFrame(data: unknown): ServerMessage | null {\n  if (typeof data !== \"string\") return null;\n  try {\n    const parsed = JSON.parse(data) as ServerMessage;\n    return parsed && typeof parsed === \"object\" && typeof parsed.t === \"string\" ? parsed : null;\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\ntype BunGlobal = { gzipSync(data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array; gunzipSync(data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array };\nconst bunZlib = (): BunGlobal | null => (typeof Bun !== \"undefined\" ? (Bun as unknown as BunGlobal) : null);\n\n/** Gzips the world-sync payload into the one binary frame of the protocol. */\nexport async function gzipWorldSync(sync: WorldSync): Promise<Uint8Array> {\n  const json = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(sync));\n  const bun = bunZlib();\n  if (bun) return bun.gzipSync(json);\n  const stream = new Blob([json]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream(\"gzip\"));\n  return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());\n}\n\n/** Reverses gzipWorldSync. Null for garbage (a client should resync, not crash). */\nexport async function gunzipWorldSync(bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<WorldSync | null> {\n  try {\n    const bun = bunZlib();\n    let json: Uint8Array;\n    if (bun) {\n      json = bun.gunzipSync(bytes);\n    } else {\n      const stream = new Blob([bytes as BlobPart]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream(\"gzip\"));\n      json = new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());\n    }\n    const parsed = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(json)) as WorldSync;\n    return parsed && parsed.t === \"worldSync\" && Array.isArray(parsed.changes) ? parsed : null;\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n"
}

{

  "content": "import { TICK_SECONDS } from \"@/lib/game/engine/tickDriver\";\n\n/**\n * Client-side server-clock estimation from ping/pong pairs: an EWMA over RTT\n * and clock offset, robust to jitter. The interpolation buffers sample\n * \"server time minus ~125ms\", so all this needs to be is smooth and roughly\n * right — not NTP.\n */\nexport type ClockSync = {\n  /** Feed one pong (echoes the ping's send time + the server's tick). */\n  onPong(sentMs: number, nowMs: number, serverTick: number): void;\n  /** Estimated server timeline position (ms on the tick clock) at local `nowMs`. */\n  estimatedServerTimeMs(nowMs: number): number;\n  /** Smoothed round-trip time (ms); 0 before the first pong. */\n  rttMs(): number;\n  /** True once at least one pong has been folded in. */\n  ready(): boolean;\n};\n\nexport function createClockSync(alpha = 0.2): ClockSync {\n  let rtt = 0;\n  let offset = 0; // serverTimeMs - localMs\n  let samples = 0;\n\n  return {\n    onPong(sentMs, nowMs, serverTick) {\n      const sampleRtt = Math.max(0, nowMs - sentMs);\n      const serverMs = serverTick * TICK_SECONDS * 1000;\n      // The pong left the server ~rtt/2 before it arrived here.\n      const sampleOffset = serverMs + sampleRtt / 2 - nowMs;\n      if (samples === 0) {\n        rtt = sampleRtt;\n        offset = sampleOffset;\n      } else {\n        rtt = rtt * (1 - alpha) + sampleRtt * alpha;\n        offset = offset * (1 - alpha) + sampleOffset * alpha;\n      }\n      samples += 1;\n    },\n    estimatedServerTimeMs(nowMs) {\n      return nowMs + offset;\n    },\n    rttMs() {\n      return rtt;\n    },\n    ready() {\n      return samples > 0;\n    }\n  };\n}\n"
}

  "new_string": "    // While mounted, the vehicle drives the player and normal walking physics are\n    // skipped; otherwise player motion runs first, then vehicles tick (so a ship can\n    // auto-board the player at their post-motion position). tickVehicles is called\n    // exactly once per player per frame in either case. Boating reports zero\n    // horizontalDistance so it doesn't inflate the walked-distance stat.\n    //\n    // Server authority: each avatar's walking is CLIENT-owned (the pose stream,\n    // clamped by applyRemotePose), so the server never integrates it — it\n    // consumes the movement summary the accepted poses synthesized instead.\n    const mounted = player.mountedVehicleId !== null;\n    let move: MoveTickResult;\n    if (mounted) {\n      tickVehicles(state, player, input, dt);\n      move = { didSprint: false, didWalk: false, didJump: false, didLand: false, landImpact: 0, horizontalDistance: 0 };\n    } else if (this.authority === \"server\") {\n      move = player.remoteMove ?? { didSprint: false, didWalk: false, didJump: false, didLand: false, landImpact: 0, horizontalDistance: 0 };\n      player.remoteMove = null;\n      tickVehicles(state, player, input, dt);\n    } else {\n      move = tickPlayerMotion(state, player, input, dt, (amount) => this.damageCombat(player, amount));\n      tickVehicles(state, player, input, dt);\n    }"
}

{

  "file_path": "/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/david/monecraft/lib/game/engine/GameEngine.ts",
  "old_string": "  /** Stores a player's latest continuous input (a server feeds each client's packet through here). */\n  setPlayerInput(playerId: PlayerId, input: FrameInput): void {\n    mustGetPlayer(this.state, playerId).input = input;\n  }",
  "new_string": "  /** Stores a player's latest continuous input (a server feeds each client's packet through here). */\n  setPlayerInput(playerId: PlayerId, input: FrameInput): void {\n    mustGetPlayer(this.state, playerId).input = input;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Applies one client-authoritative pose (server authority): sanity-clamped\n   * — horizontal speed against the sprint ceiling, vertical against jump/fall\n   * physics — and rejected wholesale on a teleport-sized jump, in which case\n   * the caller snaps the client back (forcePose). Accepted movement is\n   * synthesized into the same summary tickPlayerMotion would have produced,\n   * so hunger drain, distance stats, and fall damage stay server-authoritative\n   * even though walking isn't.\n   *\n   * `elapsedSeconds` is the time since this player's last ACCEPTED pose.\n   */\n  applyRemotePose(\n    playerId: PlayerId,\n    pose: { x: number; y: number; z: number; yaw: number; pitch: number; onGround: boolean },\n    elapsedSeconds: number\n  ): { accepted: boolean } {\n    const player = mustGetPlayer(this.state, playerId);\n    const elapsed = Math.max(elapsedSeconds, 0.01);\n    // A mounted player's pose belongs to the vehicle (server-side); ignore the stream.\n    if (player.mountedVehicleId !== null) return { accepted: false };\n\n    const dx = pose.x - player.position.x;\n    const dz = pose.z - player.position.z;\n    const dy = pose.y - player.position.y;\n    const horizontal = Math.hypot(dx, dz);\n\n    const free = isNoclip(player.gameMode) || (player.isFlying && player.gameMode === \"creative\");\n    // Generous ceilings: jitter, knockback, and catch-up bursts must not\n    // false-positive; a speedhack is an order of magnitude out anyway.\n    const maxHorizontal = (free ? FLY_SPEED : SPRINT_SPEED * speedMultiplier(player)) * 1.6 * elapsed + 0.5;\n    const maxUp = free ? FLY_SPEED * 1.6 * elapsed + 0.5 : (JUMP_VELOCITY + jumpBoostBonus(player)) * elapsed * 1.6 + 0.6;\n    const maxDown = free ? FLY_SPEED * 1.6 * elapsed + 0.5 : GRAVITY * 2 * Math.max(elapsed, 0.5) * elapsed + 2;\n\n    if (horizontal > maxHorizontal || dy > maxUp || -dy > maxDown) return { accepted: false };\n\n    const wasGrounded = player.onGround;\n    const verticalSpeed = dy / elapsed;\n    player.position.set(pose.x, pose.y, pose.z);\n    player.yaw = pose.yaw;\n    player.pitch = Math.max(-Math.PI / 2 + 0.01, Math.min(Math.PI / 2 - 0.01, pose.pitch));\n    player.onGround = pose.onGround;\n\n    // Landing: the same threshold/formula as tickPlayerMotion, on the\n    // velocity the pose stream implies (Feather Falling honored, armor path).\n    const didLand = !wasGrounded && pose.onGround && verticalSpeed < 0;\n    if (!free && didLand && verticalSpeed < -14) {\n      const raw = Math.min(19, Math.floor((-verticalSpeed - 13) * 0.5));\n      const softened = raw * (1 - featherFallingReduction(player.equippedArmor.boots));\n      this.damageCombat(player, Math.max(1, Math.round(softened)));\n    }\n\n    const moving = horizontal > 1e-3;\n    const didSprint = moving && player.input.move.sprint && !player.input.move.crouch;\n    const previous = player.remoteMove;\n    player.remoteMove = {\n      didSprint,\n      didWalk: moving && !didSprint,\n      didJump: (previous?.didJump ?? false) || (wasGrounded && !pose.onGround && verticalSpeed > 2),\n      didLand: (previous?.didLand ?? false) || didLand,\n      landImpact: didLand ? -verticalSpeed : (previous?.landImpact ?? 0),\n      horizontalDistance: (previous?.horizontalDistance ?? 0) + horizontal\n    };\n    return { accepted: true };\n  }"
}

  "content": "import { eq } from \"drizzle-orm\";\nimport { db as liveDb, schema, type Db } from \"@/db\";\nimport { readSave } from \"@/lib/game/save\";\nimport type { SaveData } from \"@/lib/game/types\";\nimport { gunzipWorldSync } from \"@/lib/net/codec\";\n\n/**\n * Room persistence: where a world's row and gzipped v17 save blob live.\n * Postgres (the same tables the web API writes) in production; the in-memory\n * adapter backs tests and PERSISTENCE=memory mode (DB-less local iteration\n * and the Playwright multiplayer spec — unknown world ids are auto-created\n * with a seed derived from the id).\n */\n\nexport type WorldRecord = {\n  id: string;\n  seed: number;\n  worldType: string;\n  difficulty: string;\n  hardcore: boolean;\n  save: SaveData | null;\n};\n\nexport type Persistence = {\n  loadWorld(worldId: string): Promise<WorldRecord | null>;\n  storeWorld(worldId: string, blob: Uint8Array, saveVersion: number): Promise<void>;\n};\n\n/** Parses a stored gzipped SaveData blob through the full readSave validation/migration chain. */\nexport async function parseSaveBlob(blob: Uint8Array): Promise<SaveData | null> {\n  try {\n    // Reuse gunzip; then readSave via a one-key Storage shim so the entire\n    // migration + validation pipeline applies to server-loaded saves too.\n    const bun = typeof Bun !== \"undefined\" ? (Bun as unknown as { gunzipSync(d: Uint8Array): Uint8Array }) : null;\n    const json = bun\n      ? new TextDecoder().decode(bun.gunzipSync(blob))\n      : JSON.stringify(await gunzipWorldSync(blob)); // never taken on Bun; keeps the module portable\n    const shim = { getItem: () => json } as unknown as Storage;\n    return readSave(\"blob\", shim);\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\nexport function createDrizzlePersistence(database: Db = liveDb()): Persistence {\n  return {\n    async loadWorld(worldId) {\n      const [row] = await database.select().from(schema.worlds).where(eq(schema.worlds.id, worldId));\n      if (!row) return null;\n      return {\n        id: row.id,\n        seed: row.seed,\n        worldType: row.worldType,\n        difficulty: row.difficulty,\n        hardcore: row.hardcore,\n        save: row.saveBlob ? await parseSaveBlob(row.saveBlob) : null\n      };\n    },\n    async storeWorld(worldId, blob, saveVersion) {\n      await database.update(schema.worlds).set({ saveBlob: blob, saveVersion, updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(schema.worlds.id, worldId));\n    }\n  };\n}\n\n/** FNV-1a of the world id — a stable seed for auto-created memory worlds. */\nfunction seedFromId(id: string): number {\n  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;\n  for (let i = 0; i < id.length; i += 1) {\n    hash ^= id.charCodeAt(i);\n    hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193);\n  }\n  return (hash >>> 0) % 2147483647;\n}\n\nexport function createMemoryPersistence(): Persistence & { blobs: Map<string, Uint8Array> } {\n  const blobs = new Map<string, Uint8Array>();\n  return {\n    blobs,\n    async loadWorld(worldId) {\n      const blob = blobs.get(worldId);\n      return {\n        id: worldId,\n        seed: seedFromId(worldId),\n        worldType: \"default\",\n        difficulty: \"normal\",\n        hardcore: false,\n        save: blob ? await parseSaveBlob(blob) : null\n      };\n    },\n    async storeWorld(worldId, blob) {\n      blobs.set(worldId, blob);\n    }\n  };\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { Room } from \"./room\";\nimport type { Persistence } from \"./persistence\";\n\n/**\n * The rooms this process hosts: loaded on first join, evicted (persist +\n * stop) after sitting empty. MAX_ROOMS bounds memory (~74 MB of world per\n * room); joins beyond it are refused at the door so an overloaded process\n * degrades by rejecting, never by thrashing.\n */\n\nconst IDLE_EVICT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;\n\nexport class RoomRegistry {\n  private readonly rooms = new Map<string, Room>();\n  private readonly loading = new Map<string, Promise<Room | null>>();\n  private sweeper: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly persistence: Persistence,\n    private readonly maxRooms: number,\n    private readonly now: () => number = () => Date.now()\n  ) {}\n\n  startSweeper(): void {\n    this.sweeper ??= setInterval(() => void this.sweepIdle(), 30_000);\n  }\n\n  /** The room for a world, loading it from persistence on first use. Null: unknown world or at capacity. */\n  async getOrLoad(worldId: string): Promise<Room | null> {\n    const existing = this.rooms.get(worldId);\n    if (existing) return existing;\n    const inFlight = this.loading.get(worldId);\n    if (inFlight) return inFlight;\n    if (this.rooms.size >= this.maxRooms) return null;\n\n    const promise = (async (): Promise<Room | null> => {\n      const record = await this.persistence.loadWorld(worldId);\n      if (!record) return null;\n      const room = new Room(record, this.persistence, this.now);\n      room.start();\n      this.rooms.set(worldId, room);\n      return room;\n    })().finally(() => this.loading.delete(worldId));\n    this.loading.set(worldId, promise);\n    return promise;\n  }\n\n  diagnostics(): Array<ReturnType<Room[\"diagnostics\"]>> {\n    return [...this.rooms.values()].map((room) => room.diagnostics());\n  }\n\n  async sweepIdle(): Promise<void> {\n    for (const [worldId, room] of this.rooms) {\n      if (room.playerCount() === 0 && room.emptySinceMs !== null && this.now() - room.emptySinceMs > IDLE_EVICT_MS) {\n        this.rooms.delete(worldId);\n        await room.shutdown();\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  async shutdownAll(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.sweeper) clearInterval(this.sweeper);\n    const rooms = [...this.rooms.values()];\n    this.rooms.clear();\n    await Promise.all(rooms.map((room) => room.shutdown()));\n  }\n}\n"
}

Environment:\n *\n *   PORT               listen port (default 8080)\n *   GAME_TICKET_SECRET shared with the web app — REQUIRED (tickets are the door)\n *   PERSISTENCE        \"postgres\" (default; needs DATABASE_URL) or \"memory\"\n *   MAX_ROOMS          concurrent worlds in this process (default 6)\n *   ADMIN_TOKEN        guards GET /rooms diagnostics (optional)\n *\n * The socket handshake: the FIRST frame must be a valid `hello` carrying a\n * live ticket (minted by the web app) and a matching protocol version, within\n * 5 seconds — anything else closes the socket with a 4xxx code.\n */\n\nconst PORT = Number.parseInt(process.env.PORT ?? \"8080\", 10);\nconst SECRET = process.env.GAME_TICKET_SECRET;\nconst MAX_ROOMS = Number.parseInt(process.env.MAX_ROOMS ?? \"6\", 10);\nconst HELLO_DEADLINE_MS = 5000;\n\nif (!SECRET) {\n  console.error(\"GAME_TICKET_SECRET is required (see .env.example)\");\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n\nconst persistence = process.env.PERSISTENCE === \"memory\" ? createMemoryPersistence() : createDrizzlePersistence();\nconst registry = new RoomRegistry(persistence, MAX_ROOMS);\nregistry.startSweeper();\n\ntype SocketData = {\n  helloTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null;\n  room: Room | null;\n  playerId: string | null;\n};\n\nconst server = Bun.serve<SocketData, Record<string, never>>({\n  port: PORT,\n  fetch(request, bunServer) {\n    const url = new URL(request.url);\n    if (url.pathname === \"/health\") return Response.json({ ok: true, rooms: registry.diagnostics().length });\n    if (url.pathname === \"/rooms\") {\n      const token = request.headers.get(\"authorization\")?.replace(/^Bearer /, \"\");\n      if (!process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN || token !== process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN) return new Response(\"forbidden\", { status: 403 });\n      return Response.json({ rooms: registry.diagnostics() });\n    }\n    if (url.pathname === \"/ws\") {\n      const upgraded = bunServer.upgrade(request, { data: { helloTimer: null, room: null, playerId: null } satisfies SocketData });\n      if (upgraded) return undefined as unknown as Response;\n      return new Response(\"expected a websocket\", { status: 426 });\n    }\n    return new Response(\"not found\", { status: 404 });\n  },\n  websocket: {\n    open(ws) {\n      ws.data.helloTimer = setTimeout(() => ws.close(CLOSE_BAD_TICKET, \"no hello\"), HELLO_DEADLINE_MS);\n    },\n    async message(ws, raw) {\n      const message = decodeClientFrame(typeof raw === \"string\" ? raw : null);\n      if (!message) return;\n\n      // Pre-admission: only a valid hello gets past this block.\n      if (!ws.data.room) {\n        if (message.t !== \"hello\") return;\n        if (ws.data.helloTimer) clearTimeout(ws.data.helloTimer);\n        if (message.protocol !== PROTOCOL_VERSION) return ws.close(CLOSE_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH, `server speaks v${PROTOCOL_VERSION}`);\n        const claims = await verifyTicket(message.ticket, SECRET!);\n        if (!claims || claims.pv !== PROTOCOL_VERSION) return ws.close(CLOSE_BAD_TICKET, \"invalid ticket\");\n        const room = await registry.getOrLoad(claims.wid);\n        if (!room) return ws.close(CLOSE_ROOM_FULL, \"no room available\");\n        const sink: ClientSink = {\n          send: (data) => void ws.send(data),\n          close: (code, reason) => ws.close(code, reason),\n          bufferedAmount: () => ws.getBufferedAmount()\n        };\n        if (await room.join(claims, sink)) {\n          ws.data.room = room;\n          ws.data.playerId = claims.sub;\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n\n      if (ws.data.playerId) await ws.data.room.handleMessage(ws.data.playerId, message);\n    },\n    close(ws) {\n      if (ws.data.helloTimer) clearTimeout(ws.data.helloTimer);\n      if (ws.data.room && ws.data.playerId) ws.data.room.leave(ws.data.playerId);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\nconsole.log(`monecraft game server on :${server.port} (${process.env.PERSISTENCE === \"memory\" ? \"memory\" : \"postgres\"} persistence, ≤${MAX_ROOMS} rooms)`);\n\n// Fly sends SIGTERM on deploy/stop: drain every room (persist + close) first.\nfor (const signal of [\"SIGTERM\", \"SIGINT\"] as const) {\n  process.on(signal, () => {\n    void registry.shutdownAll().then(() => process.exit(0));\n  });\n}\n"
}

On a server the\n   * primary may not exist — per-player attribution of world-event progress is\n   * a known multiplayer refinement; until then a shared world tracks none.\n   */\n  private observeProgress(event: GameEvent): void {\n    const primary = this.state.players.get(this.state.primaryPlayerId);\n    if (!primary) return;\n    recordEvent(primary, event);\n    for (const id of evaluateAdvancements(primary)) {\n      primary.advancements.add(id);\n      this.emit({ type: \"advancementUnlocked\", id, name: ADVANCEMENTS_BY_ID[id].title });\n    }\n  }"
}

i < 100; i += 1) {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(`http://localhost:${PORT}/health`);\n      if (response.ok) return;\n    } catch {\n      /* not up yet */\n    }\n    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));\n  }\n  throw new Error(\"game server did not come up\");\n}, 20000);\n\nafterAll(() => {\n  proc?.kill();\n});\n\ndescribe(\"game server over a real socket\", () => {\n  test(\"hello with a valid ticket → welcome + binary world sync; garbage ticket → 4000\", async () => {\n    const ticket = await signTicket({ sub: \"smoke-1\", wid: \"smoke-world\", name: \"Smoke\", skinId: null, role: \"owner\", pv: PROTOCOL_VERSION }, SECRET);\n\n    const ws = new WebSocket(`ws://localhost:${PORT}/ws`);\n    ws.binaryType = \"arraybuffer\";\n    const frames: Array<string | ArrayBuffer> = [];\n    const welcome = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {\n      const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(\"no welcome\")), 15000);\n      ws.onmessage = (event) => {\n        frames.push(event.data as string | ArrayBuffer);\n        // welcome (text) + worldSync (binary) both in → done.\n        if (frames.some((f) => typeof f === \"string\") && frames.some((f) => typeof f !== \"string\")) {\n          clearTimeout(timer);\n          resolve();\n        }\n      };\n      ws.onopen = () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: \"hello\", ticket, protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION }));\n    });\n    await welcome;\n    const text = frames.find((f) => typeof f === \"string\") as string;\n    expect(JSON.parse(text)).toMatchObject({ t: \"welcome\", playerId: \"smoke-1\", worldId: \"smoke-world\" });\n    const binary = frames.find((f) => typeof f !== \"string\") as ArrayBuffer;\n    expect(binary.byteLength).toBeGreaterThan(16);\n    ws.close();\n\n    const bad = new WebSocket(`ws://localhost:${PORT}/ws`);\n    const closed = new Promise<number>((resolve) => {\n      bad.onclose = (event) => resolve(event.code);\n      bad.onopen = () => bad.send(JSON.stringify({ t: \"hello\", ticket: \"garbage\", protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION }));\n    });\n    expect(await closed).toBe(4000);\n  }, 30000);\n\n  test(\"/health answers; /rooms requires the admin token\", async () => {\n    expect((await fetch(`http://localhost:${PORT}/health`)).ok).toBe(true);\n    expect((await fetch(`http://localhost:${PORT}/rooms`)).status).toBe(403);\n  });\n});\n"
}

  "file_path": "/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/david/monecraft/scripts/netProbe.ts",
  "content": "/**\n * A tiny CLI game client for poking a live game server (local or staging)\n * without a browser:\n *\n *   GAME_TICKET_SECRET=… bun scripts/netProbe.ts ws://localhost:8080 my-world\n *\n * Mints its own ticket (so the secret must match the server's), joins, walks\n * forward for a few seconds, and logs every message class it sees.\n */\nimport { PROTOCOL_VERSION } from \"@/lib/net/protocol\";\nimport { gunzipWorldSync } from \"@/lib/net/codec\";\nimport { signTicket } from \"@/lib/net/tickets\";\n\nconst [, , urlArg, worldArg] = process.argv;\nconst url = urlArg ?? \"ws://localhost:8080\";\nconst worldId = worldArg ?? \"probe-world\";\nconst secret = process.env.GAME_TICKET_SECRET;\nif (!secret) {\n  console.error(\"GAME_TICKET_SECRET required (must match the server)\");\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n\nconst ticket = await signTicket({ sub: `probe-${Date.now() % 100000}`, wid: worldId, name: \"Probe\", skinId: null, role: \"member\", pv: PROTOCOL_VERSION }, secret);\nconst ws = new WebSocket(`${url}/ws`);\nws.binaryType = \"arraybuffer\";\n\nlet seq = 0;\nlet pose: { x: number; y: number; z: number } | null = null;\nconst counts = new Map<string, number>();\n\nws.onopen = () => {\n  console.log(\"connected — sending hello\");\n  ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: \"hello\", ticket, protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION }));\n};\nws.onclose = (event) => {\n  console.log(`closed: ${event.code} ${event.reason}`);\n  console.log(\"message counts:\", Object.fromEntries(counts));\n  process.exit(0);\n};\nws.onmessage = async (event) => {\n  if (typeof event.data !== \"string\") {\n    const sync = await gunzipWorldSync(new Uint8Array(event.data as ArrayBuffer));\n    console.log(`worldSync: ${sync?.changes.length} block changes, ${sync?.players.length} players, ${sync?.liveMobs.length} mobs`);\n    counts.set(\"worldSync\", (counts.get(\"worldSync\") ?? 0) + 1);\n    return;\n  }\n  const message = JSON.parse(event.data) as { t: string } & Record<string, unknown>;\n  counts.set(message.t, (counts.get(message.t) ?? 0) + 1);\n  if (message.t === \"welcome\") {\n    console.log(\"welcome:\", message.playerId, \"world seed\", message.seed);\n  }\n  if (message.t === \"tick\" && !pose) {\n    // Adopt whatever spawn the server gave us, then start walking.\n    const self = message.self as { hearts?: number } | undefined;\n    if (self) console.log(\"self:\", JSON.stringify(self).slice(0, 120));\n    pose = { x: 256, y: 80, z: 256 };\n  }\n};\n\nconst move = { forward: true, back: false, left: false, right: false, jump: false, sprint: false, crouch: false };\nsetInterval(() => {\n  if (ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN || !pose) return;\n  pose.z -= 0.2; // amble north at ~4 blocks/s\n  seq += 1;\n  ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: \"pose\", seq, ...pose, yaw: 0, pitch: 0, onGround: true, move, mineHeld: false }));\n  if (seq % 40 === 0) ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: \"ping\", id: seq, tMs: Date.now() }));\n}, 50);\n\nsetTimeout(() => {\n  console.log(\"probe done\");\n  ws.close();\n}, 8000);\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/david/monecraft/docs/protocol.md",
  "content": "# Wire protocol (v1)\n\nThe client↔game-server protocol, defined in `lib/net/protocol.ts` (single\nsource of truth — this page is the narrative). Versioned as a whole via\n`PROTOCOL_VERSION`; join tickets stamp it, and a mismatch is refused at the\ndoor, so format drift mid-session cannot happen.\n\n## Transport & framing\n\nWebSocket to the game server's `/ws`. Everything is a JSON text frame\ndiscriminated on `t`, except **one binary frame**: the world sync (join and\n`resync`), which is gzipped JSON — a fresh world's block diff is bytes, a\nterraformed one compresses >2×. Hot paths (pose/tick) can move to packed\nbinary later without renegotiating anything: the envelope shape is the\ncontract, not the encoding.\n\n## Handshake\n\n1. Client connects and must send `hello { ticket, protocol }` within **5s**.\n2. The server verifies the ticket (HS256, 60s TTL, minted by the web API —\n   see [online.md](online.md)), checks `protocol === PROTOCOL_VERSION`, loads\n   the room, and answers `welcome` + the binary `worldSync`.\n3. Anything else → close with an application code (below).\n\nA client regenerates the world from `welcome.seed` (bit-identical since\nworldgen v11 — see [testing.md](testing.md)) and applies `worldSync.changes`;\nthe join payload is KBs, not the 37 MB voxel field.\n\n## Steady state\n\n**Client → server**\n- `pose` @20 Hz — client-authoritative avatar movement + live intents.\n  Clamped server-side (sprint-ceiling speed, jump/fall vertical, teleport\n  rejection → `forcePose`); accepted movement drives server-side hunger,\n  distance stats, and fall damage.\n- `cmd` — a discrete `Command` + the claimed eye pose (applied through the\n  same clamps before dispatch, so aimed raycasts resolve where the client\n  looked). Validated against a per-type **allow-list**; local-presentation\n  commands (pause/debug/camera) never travel. Budget: 60/s.\n- `chat` (≤256 chars, 3/s), `ping`, `resync`.\n\n**Server → client**\n- `tick { n, ev, pp, mp, day?, self? }` @20 Hz — world events since last\n  tick (block edits ride these), other players' poses, deadbanded mob poses\n  (~10 Hz), the day clock every second, and `self`: the private, server-\n  authoritative delta of YOUR state (inventory/hearts/hunger/xp/effects/…),\n  sent only on change.\n- `mobsKeyframe` every 5s (drift correction), `playerJoined`/`playerLeft`,\n  `container` (open-chest updates), `chat`, `pong`, `forcePose`.\n\nBackpressure: past 256 KB buffered, a client's `pp`/`mp` are shed (events\nand `self` still flow); sustained >1 MB is a `4008` kick.\n\n## Close codes\n\n| Code | Meaning |\n| ---- | ------- |\n| 4000 | bad/expired ticket (or no hello in time) |\n| 4001 | protocol version mismatch |\n| 4002 | room full (8 players) or server at MAX_ROOMS |\n| 4003 | kicked (owner action, or replaced by a reconnect) |\n| 4004 | idle timeout |\n| 4005 | server shutting down (redeploy — reconnect after) |\n| 4008 | slow client (sustained backpressure) |\n\n## Trust model\n\nThe server is authoritative for the world: every gameplay command executes\nin ITS engine; clients cannot invent items or edits. The one client-owned\nthing is each avatar's own movement (clamped, never trusted blindly). The\nclaimed eye pose on `cmd` is the hybrid model's soft spot — acceptable for\ninvite-only co-op, and the envelope already carries what stricter server-side\nrewind validation would need.\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/david/monecraft/lib/net/interpolation.ts",
  "content": "/**\n * Entity interpolation: remote players and mobs render ~125 ms in the past,\n * lerped between the two authoritative samples that bracket the target time.\n * Pure math over per-entity ring buffers — no engine, no sockets.\n */\n\nexport const INTERPOLATION_DELAY_MS = 125;\nconst BUFFER_SIZE = 32; // ~1.6s of 20 Hz samples\n\nexport type PoseSample = { tMs: number; x: number; y: number; z: number; yaw: number; pitch?: number };\nexport type InterpolatedPose = { x: number; y: number; z: number; yaw: number; pitch: number };\n\n/** Shortest-path angular lerp (yaw wraps at ±π). */\nexport function lerpAngle(a: number, b: number, t: number): number {\n  const TWO_PI = Math.PI * 2;\n  let delta = (b - a) % TWO_PI;\n  if (delta > Math.PI) delta -= TWO_PI;\n  if (delta < -Math.PI) delta += TWO_PI;\n  return a + delta * t;\n}\n\nexport type PoseBuffer = {\n  push(sample: PoseSample): void;\n  /** The pose at `renderTimeMs` (already delay-adjusted by the caller), or null before two samples exist. */\n  sample(renderTimeMs: number): InterpolatedPose | null;\n  /** Latest raw sample (for spawn placement / distance checks). */\n  latest(): PoseSample | null;\n};\n\nexport function createPoseBuffer(): PoseBuffer {\n  const samples: PoseSample[] = [];\n\n  return {\n    push(sample) {\n      // Out-of-order or duplicate timestamps replace rather than interleave.\n      const last = samples[samples.length - 1];\n      if (last && sample.tMs <= last.tMs) {\n        samples[samples.length - 1] = sample;\n        return;\n      }\n      samples.push(sample);\n      if (samples.length > BUFFER_SIZE) samples.shift();\n    },\n\n    sample(renderTimeMs) {\n      if (samples.length === 0) return null;\n      const first = samples[0];\n      const last = samples[samples.length - 1];\n      // Behind the buffer: clamp to the oldest we know.\n      if (renderTimeMs <= first.tMs) return { x: first.x, y: first.y, z: first.z, yaw: first.yaw, pitch: first.pitch ?? 0 };\n      // Ahead of the buffer (stalled stream): clamp to the newest — never extrapolate.\n      if (renderTimeMs >= last.tMs) return { x: last.x, y: last.y, z: last.z, yaw: last.yaw, pitch: last.pitch ?? 0 };\n      let after = 1;\n      while (samples[after].tMs < renderTimeMs) after += 1;\n      const b = samples[after];\n      const a = samples[after - 1];\n      const t = (renderTimeMs - a.tMs) / Math.max(1e-6, b.tMs - a.tMs);\n      return {\n        x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t,\n        y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t,\n        z: a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t,\n        yaw: lerpAngle(a.yaw, b.yaw, t),\n        pitch: lerpAngle(a.pitch ?? 0, b.pitch ?? 0, t)\n      };\n    },\n\n    latest() {\n      return samples[samples.length - 1] ?? null;\n    }\n  };\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { describe, expect, test } from \"bun:test\";\nimport { createPoseBuffer, lerpAngle } from \"./interpolation\";\n\ndescribe(\"pose interpolation\", () => {\n  test(\"lerps position and yaw between bracketing samples\", () => {\n    const buffer = createPoseBuffer();\n    buffer.push({ tMs: 1000, x: 0, y: 64, z: 0, yaw: 0 });\n    buffer.push({ tMs: 1050, x: 1, y: 64, z: 2, yaw: 0.4 });\n    const mid = buffer.sample(1025)!;\n    expect(mid.x).toBeCloseTo(0.5, 9);\n    expect(mid.z).toBeCloseTo(1, 9);\n    expect(mid.yaw).toBeCloseTo(0.2, 9);\n  });\n\n  test(\"clamps rather than extrapolating on a stalled stream\", () => {\n    const buffer = createPoseBuffer();\n    buffer.push({ tMs: 1000, x: 0, y: 64, z: 0, yaw: 0 });\n    buffer.push({ tMs: 1050, x: 5, y: 64, z: 0, yaw: 0 });\n    expect(buffer.sample(500)!.x).toBe(0);\n    expect(buffer.sample(9999)!.x).toBe(5); // frozen at the last known pose\n  });\n\n  test(\"yaw takes the short way around the wrap\", () => {\n    expect(lerpAngle(Math.PI - 0.1, -Math.PI + 0.1, 0.5)).toBeCloseTo(Math.PI, 5);\n    expect(lerpAngle(-Math.PI + 0.1, Math.PI - 0.1, 0.5)).toBeCloseTo(-Math.PI, 5);\n    expect(lerpAngle(0.1, 0.3, 0.5)).toBeCloseTo(0.2, 9);\n  });\n\n  test(\"out-of-order samples replace instead of corrupting the timeline\", () => {\n    const buffer = createPoseBuffer();\n    buffer.push({ tMs: 1000, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, yaw: 0 });\n    buffer.push({ tMs: 1100, x: 10, y: 0, z: 0, yaw: 0 });\n    buffer.push({ tMs: 1050, x: 99, y: 0, z: 0, yaw: 0 }); // late arrival\n    expect(buffer.latest()!.x).toBe(99);\n    expect(buffer.latest()!.tMs).toBe(1100);\n    const mid = buffer.sample(1050)!;\n    expect(mid.x).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);\n    expect(mid.x).toBeLessThanOrEqual(99);\n  });\n});\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/david/monecraft/lib/game/engine/blockChanges.ts",
  "content": "import { applyEdit, BlockId, VoxelWorld } from \"@/lib/world\";\n\n/**\n * Tracks player edits to the generated world as deltas against the worldgen\n * baseline — the heart of the save format. A block restored to its original\n * value drops out of the delta set, keeping saves minimal.\n *\n * The tracker also journals every write since the last drain: a multiplayer\n * server broadcasts exactly that journal each tick, because gameplay events\n * alone can't reconstruct multi-cell edits (an explosion crater, a kelp\n * stalk refilling with water, a door's two cells).\n */\nexport type BlockChangeTracker = {\n  /** Tracked write: updates the world and the delta set. */\n  set(x: number, y: number, z: number, block: BlockId): void;\n  /** Replays saved deltas onto a freshly generated world (boot only). */\n  applySavedChanges(changes: Array<[number, number]>): void;\n  /** Current deltas as [voxelIndex, blockId] pairs, ready to persist. */\n  changes(): Array<[number, number]>;\n  /** Every write since the last drain (a server's per-tick block broadcast). */\n  drainEdits(): Array<[number, number]>;\n};\n\nexport function createBlockChangeTracker(world: VoxelWorld): BlockChangeTracker {\n  const changedBlocks = new Map<number, number>();\n  const baselineByIndex = new Map<number, number>();\n  // Last-write-wins within a tick window; drained by the server each tick.\n  let editJournal = new Map<number, number>();\n\n  return {\n    set(x, y, z, block) {\n      if (!world.inBounds(x, y, z)) return;\n      const idx = world.index(x, y, z);\n      if (!baselineByIndex.has(idx)) baselineByIndex.set(idx, world.get(x, y, z));\n      world.set(x, y, z, block);\n      // Patch lighting locally now the block changed. This is the single\n      // chokepoint for every gameplay edit (mining, doors, farming, crop\n      // growth), so each one relights without the renderer doing anything; the\n      // load path (applySavedChanges) bypasses this and the full bake covers it.\n      applyEdit(world, world.light, x, y, z);\n      const baseline = baselineByIndex.get(idx) ?? BlockId.Air;\n      if (block === baseline) changedBlocks.delete(idx);\n      else changedBlocks.set(idx, block);\n      editJournal.set(idx, block);\n    },\n\n    applySavedChanges(changes) {\n      const layer = world.sizeX * world.sizeZ;\n      for (const [idx, block] of changes) {\n        const y = Math.floor(idx / layer);\n        const rem = idx - y * layer;\n        const z = Math.floor(rem / world.sizeX);\n        const x = rem - z * world.sizeX;\n        if (!world.inBounds(x, y, z)) continue;\n        world.set(x, y, z, block as BlockId);\n        changedBlocks.set(idx, block);\n      }\n    },\n\n    changes() {\n      return [...changedBlocks.entries()];\n    },\n\n    drainEdits() {\n      if (editJournal.size === 0) return [];\n      const drained = [...editJournal.entries()];\n      editJournal = new Map();\n      return drained;\n    }\n  };\n}\n"
}

47	export function createPlayerVisuals(scene: THREE.Scene): PlayerVisuals {
48	  const model = createPlayerModel();

51

53	  let heldKey = "";

55	  let swingStartMs = -Infinity;
56	  let castQueued = false;
57	  let castStartMs = -Infinity;
58	  let reelQueued = false;

60	  let wasMining = false;
61	
62	  const clearHeldModel = () => {
63	    if (!heldModel) return;
64	    model.itemHolder.remove(heldModel.object);
65	    heldModel.geometry.dispose();
66	    heldModel.material.dispose();
67	    heldModel = null;
68	    heldKey = "";
69	  };
70	
71	  const syncHeldItem = (slot: InventorySlot | undefined) => {
72	    const nextKey = slot?.id && slot.count > 0 && slot.kind ? slot.id : "";
73	    if (nextKey === heldKey) return;
74	    clearHeldModel();
75	    const built = buildItemModel(slot);
76	    if (built) {
77	      heldModel = built;
78	      heldKey = nextKey;
79	      model.itemHolder.add(built.object);
80	    }
81	  };
82	
83	  return {
84	    sync(state, timeMs) {
85	      // Spectator is unseen — the body stays hidden even in third-person.
86	      const visible = state.cameraMode !== "first" && !state.isDead && state.gameMode !== "spectator";
87	      model.group.visible = visible;
88	      if (!visible) {
89	        // Don't replay stale one-shots when the body next becomes visible.
90	        swingQueued = false;
91	        castQueued = false;
92	        reelQueued = false;
93	        return;
94	      }
95	
96	      const { player } = state;

98	      model.group.rotation.y = player.yaw;

100	
101	      syncHeldItem(state.inventory[state.selectedSlot]);
102	
103	      const miningActive = state.mining.targetKey !== "";
104	      if (swingQueued) {
105	        swingQueued = false;
106	        swingStartMs = timeMs;
107	      }
108	      if (castQueued) {
109	        castQueued = false;
110	        castStartMs = timeMs;
111	      }
112	      if (reelQueued) {
113	        reelQueued = false;
114	        reelStartMs = timeMs;
115	      }
116	      if (miningActive && !wasMining) swingStartMs = timeMs;
117	      wasMining = miningActive;
118	
119	      const moveFactor = player.onGround ? Math.min(1, Math.hypot(player.velocity.x, player.velocity.z) / WALK_SPEED) : 0;
120	      const pose = computePlayerPose({

123	        miningActive,
124	        swingStartMs,

126	        reelStartMs,

128	      });

130	      model.rightArm.rotation.x = pose.rightArmX;
131	      model.leftLeg.rotation.x = pose.leftLegX;
132	      model.rightLeg.rotation.x = pose.rightLegX;
133	
134	      // Show the shell for each worn armor piece (hide the rest).
135	      for (const slot of ARMOR_SLOTS) {
136	        const worn = state.equippedArmor[slot] != null;
137	        for (const mesh of model.armor[slot]) mesh.visible = worn;
138	      }
139	    },
140	
141	    triggerSwing() {
142	      swingQueued = true;
143	    },
144	
145	    triggerCast() {
146	      castQueued = true;
147	    },
148	
149	    triggerReel() {
150	      reelQueued = true;
151	    },
152	
153	    getRodTip(out) {
154	      // Flush the holder's parent chain (group → right arm → holder) so the world
155	      // position is current this frame, not one frame stale. Call after sync().
156	      model.itemHolder.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);

167	      for (const material of model.materials) material.dispose();

  "content": "import * as THREE from \"three\";\nimport { WALK_SPEED } from \"@/lib/game/config\";\nimport type { PlayerId, PlayerState } from \"@/lib/game/engine/state\";\nimport { DEFAULT_PLAYER_PALETTE, SKIN_PRESETS, type SkinId } from \"@/lib/game/playerSkins\";\nimport { applyPalette, createPlayerModel, type PlayerModel } from \"./playerModel\";\nimport { computePlayerPose } from \"./playerPose\";\n\n/**\n * Other players' bodies in a multiplayer world: one humanoid per remote\n * PlayerState (the same procedural model/pose math as the local third-person\n * body) plus a floating name tag — a canvas-drawn sprite, in line with the\n * zero-asset rule (mirrors the renderer's hostile health bars). Poses arrive\n * already interpolated (NetworkSession writes them into state.players), so\n * this layer only mirrors state → scene, estimating gait from frame-to-frame\n * movement.\n */\n\nexport type RemotePlayerInfo = { name: string; skinId: string | null };\n\nexport type RemotePlayerVisuals = {\n  /** Reconciles models with state.players (minus the primary). Call once per frame. */\n  sync(players: Map<PlayerId, PlayerState>, primaryId: PlayerId, info: (id: PlayerId) => RemotePlayerInfo, timeMs: number): void;\n  dispose(): void;\n};\n\nfunction makeNameTag(name: string): { sprite: THREE.Sprite; texture: THREE.Texture; material: THREE.SpriteMaterial } {\n  const canvas = document.createElement(\"canvas\");\n  canvas.width = 256;\n  canvas.height = 48;\n  const ctx = canvas.getContext(\"2d\")!;\n  ctx.fillStyle = \"rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)\";\n  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);\n  ctx.font = \"28px monospace\";\n  ctx.textAlign = \"center\";\n  ctx.textBaseline = \"middle\";\n  ctx.fillStyle = \"#ffffff\";\n  ctx.fillText(name.slice(0, 16), canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);\n  const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);\n  texture.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;\n  const material = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: texture, depthTest: false, transparent: true });\n  const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(material);\n  sprite.scale.set(1.6, 0.3, 1);\n  sprite.position.y = 1.35; // above the head (model origin is the body center)\n  return { sprite, texture, material };\n}\n\ntype RemoteEntry = {\n  model: PlayerModel;\n  tag: ReturnType<typeof makeNameTag>;\n  lastPosition: THREE.Vector3;\n  lastTimeMs: number;\n  skinKey: string;\n};\n\nexport function createRemotePlayerVisuals(scene: THREE.Scene): RemotePlayerVisuals {\n  const entries = new Map<PlayerId, RemoteEntry>();\n\n  const remove = (id: PlayerId) => {\n    const entry = entries.get(id);\n    if (!entry) return;\n    scene.remove(entry.model.group);\n    for (const material of entry.model.materials) material.dispose();\n    for (const geometry of entry.model.geometries) geometry.dispose();\n    entry.tag.texture.dispose();\n    entry.tag.material.dispose();\n    entries.delete(id);\n  };\n\n  return {\n    sync(players, primaryId, info, timeMs) {\n      for (const [id, player] of players) {\n        if (id === primaryId) continue;\n        let entry = entries.get(id);\n        if (!entry) {\n          const model = createPlayerModel();\n          const meta = info(id);\n          const tag = makeNameTag(meta.name);\n          model.group.add(tag.sprite);\n          scene.add(model.group);\n          entry = { model, tag, lastPosition: player.position.clone(), lastTimeMs: timeMs, skinKey: \"\" };\n          entries.set(id, entry);\n        }\n        const meta = info(id);\n        if (entry.skinKey !== (meta.skinId ?? \"default\")) {\n          entry.skinKey = meta.skinId ?? \"default\";\n          const preset = SKIN_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === (entry!.skinKey as SkinId));\n          applyPalette(entry.model, preset?.palette ?? DEFAULT_PLAYER_PALETTE);\n        }\n\n        entry.model.group.position.copy(player.position);\n        entry.model.group.rotation.y = player.yaw;\n        entry.model.head.rotation.x = player.pitch;\n\n        // Gait from observed movement (poses are interpolated, velocity is unknown).\n        const dtMs = Math.max(1, timeMs - entry.lastTimeMs);\n        const speed = (entry.lastPosition.distanceTo(player.position) / dtMs) * 1000;\n        entry.lastPosition.copy(player.position);\n        entry.lastTimeMs = timeMs;\n        const pose = computePlayerPose({\n          timeMs,\n          moveFactor: Math.min(1, speed / WALK_SPEED),\n          miningActive: player.mining.targetKey !== \"\",\n          swingStartMs: -Infinity,\n          castStartMs: -Infinity,\n          reelStartMs: -Infinity,\n          fishingActive: false\n        });\n        entry.model.leftArm.rotation.x = pose.leftArmX;\n        entry.model.rightArm.rotation.x = pose.rightArmX;\n        entry.model.leftLeg.rotation.x = pose.leftLegX;\n        entry.model.rightLeg.rotation.x = pose.rightLegX;\n        entry.model.group.visible = !player.isDead;\n      }\n\n      // Gone players drop their models.\n      for (const id of [...entries.keys()]) {\n        if (!players.has(id) || id === primaryId) remove(id);\n      }\n    },\n\n    dispose() {\n      for (const id of [...entries.keys()]) remove(id);\n    }\n  };\n}\n"
}

poke a re-render at 1 Hz while any are visible.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (entries.length === 0) return;\n    const timer = window.setInterval(() => forceFade((n) => n + 1), 1000);\n    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);\n  }, [entries.length]);\n\n  const openChat = useCallback(() => {\n    setOpen(true);\n    onOpenChange?.(true);\n    if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock();\n    // Focus after the input exists.\n    window.setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 0);\n  }, [onOpenChange]);\n\n  const closeChat = useCallback(() => {\n    setOpen(false);\n    setDraft(\"\");\n    onOpenChange?.(false);\n  }, [onOpenChange]);\n\n  // T / Enter opens while playing (not while another overlay owns the keys).\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {\n      if (open) return;\n      if (!locked) return; // only from live gameplay — menus own their keys\n      if (event.code === \"KeyT\" || event.code === \"Enter\") {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        openChat();\n      }\n    };\n    document.addEventListener(\"keydown\", onKeyDown);\n    return () => document.removeEventListener(\"keydown\", onKeyDown);\n  }, [open, locked, openChat]);\n\n  const now = performance.now();\n  const visible = open ? entries : entries.filter((entry) => now - entry.atMs < FADE_AFTER_MS);\n\n  return (\n    <div className={open ? \"chat-panel open\" : \"chat-panel\"}>\n      <ul className=\"chat-log\" aria-live=\"polite\">\n        {visible.map((entry) => (\n          <li key={entry.id} className=\"chat-line\">\n            <span className=\"chat-name\">{entry.name}</span> {entry.text}\n          </li>\n        ))}\n      </ul>\n      {open && (\n        <form\n          className=\"chat-input-row\"\n          onSubmit={(event) => {\n            event.preventDefault();\n            session.sendChat(draft);\n            closeChat();\n          }}\n        >\n          <input\n            ref={inputRef}\n            className=\"chat-input\"\n            value={draft}\n            maxLength={256}\n            placeholder=\"Say something…\"\n            onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}\n            onKeyDown={(event) => {\n              if (event.key === \"Escape\") {\n                event.preventDefault();\n                closeChat();\n              }\n              event.stopPropagation(); // typing must not move the player\n            }}\n          />\n        </form>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

  "content": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport type { NetStatus, NetworkSession } from \"@/lib/net/NetworkSession\";\n\n/**\n * The online HUD corner: ping while healthy, a banner while degraded, and a\n * modal when the connection is gone (the world keeps rendering underneath —\n * the player leaves through the button, never a dead-end).\n */\nexport default function ConnectionStatus({ session, onLeave }: { session: NetworkSession; onLeave: () => void }) {\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState<NetStatus>(session.status());\n  const [rtt, setRtt] = useState(0);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    session.onStatusChange = setStatus;\n    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setRtt(Math.round(session.rttMs())), 1000);\n    return () => {\n      session.onStatusChange = null;\n      window.clearInterval(timer);\n    };\n  }, [session]);\n\n  if (status === \"closed\") {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"net-modal\" role=\"alertdialog\" aria-label=\"Disconnected\">\n        <div className=\"net-modal-box\">\n          <p>Disconnected from the server.</p>\n          <button type=\"button\" className=\"mc-button\" onClick={onLeave}>\n            Back to worlds\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"net-status\" aria-live=\"off\">\n      {status === \"online\" ? `${rtt} ms` : status}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

3	import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
4	import MinecraftGame from "@/components/MinecraftGame";
5	import ProfileSelect from "@/components/menu/ProfileSelect";
6	import WorldSelect from "@/components/menu/WorldSelect";
7	import { migrateLegacySave } from "@/lib/game/legacyMigration";
8	import { getProfile, setActiveProfile } from "@/lib/game/profiles";
9	import { deleteWorld, getWorld, touchWorld } from "@/lib/game/worlds";
10	import { installUiTiles } from "@/lib/ui/chromeTiles";
11	
12	/**
13	 * Top-level menu shell. Owns the screen state machine (profile-select ->
14	 * world-select -> play) and boots the legacy migration once on mount. The play
15	 * screen mounts MinecraftGame keyed by world id + a reload nonce, so switching
16	 * worlds (or Load/Reset) remounts the subtree — the game effect's cleanup
17	 * disposes the old engine/renderer and a fresh mount boots the next world, with
18	 * no page reload.
19	 */
20	type Screen = { name: "profile-select" } | { name: "world-select"; profileId: string } | { name: "play"; profileId: string; worldId: string };
21	
22	/**
23	 * Remembers the world being played for this tab so a reload resumes it instead
24	 * of dropping back to the menu. sessionStorage (not localStorage) so a brand-new
25	 * tab still cold-starts at profile-select.
26	 */
27	const SESSION_KEY = "monecraft_active_session";
28	
29	function readSessionPointer(): { profileId: string; worldId: string } | null {
30	  try {
31	    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY);
32	    if (!raw) return null;
33	    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { profileId?: unknown; worldId?: unknown };
34	    if (typeof parsed?.profileId === "string" && typeof parsed?.worldId === "string") {
35	      return { profileId: parsed.profileId, worldId: parsed.worldId };
36	    }
37	    return null;
38	  } catch {
39	    return null;
40	  }
41	}
42	
43	function writeSessionPointer(pointer: { profileId: string; worldId: string } | null): void {
44	  try {
45	    if (pointer) sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(pointer));
46	    else sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
47	  } catch {
48	    // No resume across reload if sessionStorage is unavailable — never fatal.
49	  }
50	}
51	
52	export default function GameShell() {
53	  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
54	  const [screen, setScreen] = useState<Screen>({ name: "profile-select" });
55	  const [reloadNonce, setReloadNonce] = useState(0);
56	
57	  useEffect(() => {
58	    installUiTiles(); // the menu chrome shares the in-game noise tiles
59	    migrateLegacySave();
60	    // Resume the tab's world if one was being played and still exists.
61	    const pointer = readSessionPointer();
62	    const resume: Screen | null =
63	      pointer && getProfile(pointer.profileId) && getWorld(pointer.worldId) ? { name: "play", profileId: pointer.profileId, worldId: pointer.worldId } : null;
64	    // Microtask hop keeps this off the synchronous effect path (cascading-render lint).
65	    queueMicrotask(() => {
66	      if (resume) setScreen(resume);
67	      setReady(true);
68	    });
69	  }, []);
70	
71	  // localStorage is read below; hold the neutral frame until we're client-side.
72	  if (!ready) return <div className="menu-screen" />;
73	
74	  if (screen.name === "play") {
75	    const profile = getProfile(screen.profileId);
76	    const world = getWorld(screen.worldId);
77	    // Both exist in normal flow; a cross-tab delete drops us back to a menu.
78	    if (profile && world) {
79	      return (
80	        <MinecraftGame
81	          key={`${world.id}:${reloadNonce}`}
82	          world={world}
83	          profile={profile}
84	          onQuitToWorlds={() => {
85	            writeSessionPointer(null);
86	            setScreen({ name: "world-select", profileId: profile.id });
87	          }}
88	          onDeleteWorld={() => {
89	            deleteWorld(world.id); // hardcore Game Over: erase the dead world and leave
90	            writeSessionPointer(null);
91	            setScreen({ name: "world-select", profileId: profile.id });
92	          }}
93	          onReloadWorld={() => setReloadNonce((nonce) => nonce + 1)}
94	        />
95	      );
96	    }
97	  }
98	
99	  if (screen.name === "world-select") {
100	    const profile = getProfile(screen.profileId);
101	    if (profile) {
102	      return (
103	        <WorldSelect
104	          profile={profile}
105	          onPlay={(worldId) => {
106	            touchWorld(worldId);
107	            writeSessionPointer({ profileId: profile.id, worldId });
108	            setScreen({ name: "play", profileId: profile.id, worldId });
109	          }}
110	          onBack={() => setScreen({ name: "profile-select" })}
111	        />
112	      );
113	    }
114	  }
115	
116	  return (
117	    <ProfileSelect
118	      onPlay={(profileId) => {
119	        setActiveProfile(profileId);
120	        setScreen({ name: "world-select", profileId });
121	      }}
122	    />
123	  );
124	}
125

  "old_string": "export default function GameShell() {\n  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);\n  const [screen, setScreen] = useState<Screen>({ name: \"profile-select\" });\n  const [reloadNonce, setReloadNonce] = useState(0);",
  "new_string": "export default function GameShell() {\n  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);\n  const [screen, setScreen] = useState<Screen>({ name: \"profile-select\" });\n  const [reloadNonce, setReloadNonce] = useState(0);\n  const [connecting, setConnecting] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [connectError, setConnectError] = useState<string | null>(null);\n\n  /** Guest-or-account → ticket → socket → replica sync → play. */\n  const playOnline = async (profileId: string, world: OnlineWorld) => {\n    setConnectError(null);\n    setConnecting(world.name);\n    try {\n      if (!(await ensureSignedIn())) throw new Error(\"sign-in failed\");\n      const grant = await requestJoinTicket(world.id);\n      if (!grant) throw new Error(\"could not get a join ticket (is the game server configured?)\");\n      const session = await connectNetworkSession(grant.gameServerUrl, grant.ticket);\n      setScreen({ name: \"play-online\", profileId, world, session });\n    } catch (error) {\n      setConnectError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"connection failed\");\n    } finally {\n      setConnecting(null);\n    }\n  };"
}

  "content": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { use, useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { ensureSignedIn } from \"@/lib/auth/client\";\nimport { acceptInviteToken, resolveInviteToken } from \"@/lib/online/onlineClient\";\n\n/**\n * The invite-link landing page: resolves the token (so the world's name shows\n * before any sign-in), creates a guest identity if needed, accepts the\n * membership, and points at the game — where the world now sits in the\n * Online Worlds list. Deliberately unmagical: joining a friend's world is a\n * two-click story, not hidden state threading into the shell.\n */\nexport default function JoinPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ token: string }> }) {\n  const { token } = use(params);\n  const [state, setState] = useState<{ phase: \"loading\" } | { phase: \"joined\"; worldName: string } | { phase: \"error\"; message: string }>({\n    phase: \"loading\"\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    let cancelled = false;\n    void (async () => {\n      const invite = await resolveInviteToken(token);\n      if (!invite) return void (!cancelled && setState({ phase: \"error\", message: \"This invite link is invalid or has expired.\" }));\n      const user = await ensureSignedIn();\n      if (!user) return void (!cancelled && setState({ phase: \"error\", message: \"Could not sign you in — try again.\" }));\n      const accepted = await acceptInviteToken(token);\n      if (!accepted) return void (!cancelled && setState({ phase: \"error\", message: \"This invite could not be accepted (it may be used up).\" }));\n      if (!cancelled) setState({ phase: \"joined\", worldName: invite.worldName });\n    })();\n    return () => {\n      cancelled = true;\n    };\n  }, [token]);\n\n  return (\n    <main className=\"menu-screen join-page\">\n      <div className=\"net-modal-box\">\n        {state.phase === \"loading\" && <p>Checking your invite…</p>}\n        {state.phase === \"error\" && <p>{state.message}</p>}\n        {state.phase === \"joined\" && (\n          <>\n            <p>\n              You&apos;ve joined <strong>{state.worldName}</strong>!\n            </p>\n            <p>Open the game and press its card in Online Worlds.</p>\n          </>\n        )}\n        <Link className=\"mc-button\" href=\"/\">\n          {state.phase === \"joined\" ? \"Open the game\" : \"Back to the game\"}\n        </Link>\n      </div>\n    </main>\n  );\n}\n"
}

  "new_string": "import { drizzle } from \"drizzle-orm/postgres-js\";\nimport postgres from \"postgres\";\nimport * as schema from \"./schema\";\n\n/**\n * The Postgres connection, lazily created so importing this module never\n * requires DATABASE_URL (the client bundle types against the schema; only\n * route handlers and the game server actually connect). postgres-js runs on\n * both Node (Vercel functions) and Bun (the Fly game server); tests use the\n * PGlite driver via db/testDb.ts instead.\n *\n * `DATABASE_URL=pglite://memory` runs an EPHEMERAL in-process Postgres with\n * the schema pre-applied — the Playwright multiplayer suite and daemon-free\n * local dev use it; data lives exactly as long as the server process.\n */\n\nexport type Db = ReturnType<typeof drizzle<typeof schema>>;\n\nlet instance: Db | null = null;\n\nexport function db(): Db {\n  if (instance) return instance;\n  const url = process.env.DATABASE_URL;\n  if (!url) throw new Error(\"DATABASE_URL is not set — see .env.example\");\n  if (url.startsWith(\"pglite:\")) {\n    // Lazy requires keep PGlite (a WASM bundle) out of production paths.\n    /* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports */\n    const { PGlite } = require(\"@electric-sql/pglite\") as typeof import(\"@electric-sql/pglite\");\n    const { drizzle: drizzlePglite } = require(\"drizzle-orm/pglite\") as typeof import(\"drizzle-orm/pglite\");\n    const { SCHEMA_DDL } = require(\"./ddl\") as typeof import(\"./ddl\");\n    /* eslint-enable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports */\n    const client = new PGlite();\n    // exec() is async; PGlite queues queries behind it, so no race.\n    void client.exec(SCHEMA_DDL);\n    instance = drizzlePglite(client, { schema }) as unknown as Db;\n    return instance;\n  }\n  // Vercel Fluid Compute reuses instances; keep the pool tiny per instance.\n  instance = drizzle(postgres(url, { max: 5 }), { schema });\n  return instance;\n}\n\nexport { schema };"

4	/**
5	 * Shared E2E plumbing. Tests assert against the live simulation through the
6	 * window.__monecraft debug handle rather than pixels — see docs/testing.md.
7	 */
8	
9	export const test = base.extend<{ gamePage: Page }>({
10	  // A page that has booted the game, with console errors treated as failures.
11	  // (The fixture continuation is named `runTest`, not Playwright's
12	  // conventional `use`, to avoid colliding with React's rules-of-hooks lint.)
13	  gamePage: async ({ page }, runTest) => {
14	    const errors: string[] = [];
15	    page.on("console", (message) => {
16	      if (message.type() !== "error") return;
17	      // The app ships no favicon; Chrome's automatic /favicon.ico 404 is noise.
18	      if (message.text().includes("Failed to load resource") && message.location().url.endsWith("/favicon.ico")) return;
19	      errors.push(`${message.text()} (${message.location().url})`);
20	    });
21	    page.on("pageerror", (error) => errors.push(String(error)));
22	
23	    // Seed a known profile + world so the menu has something to enter. Runs on
24	    // every navigation (including reloads), but only fills the manifests when
25	    // absent so a test's own writes survive a reload.
26	    await page.addInitScript((worldgenVersion) => {
27	      if (!localStorage.getItem("minecraft_profiles_v1")) {
28	        localStorage.setItem(
29	          "minecraft_profiles_v1",
30	          JSON.stringify({ version: 1, profiles: [{ id: "e2e-profile", name: "Tester", skinId: "default", createdAt: 1 }], activeProfileId: "e2e-profile" })
31	        );
32	      }
33	      if (!localStorage.getItem("minecraft_worlds_v1")) {
34	        localStorage.setItem(
35	          "minecraft_worlds_v1",
36	          JSON.stringify({
37	            version: 1,
38	            worlds: [{ id: "e2e-world", profileId: "e2e-profile", name: "Test World", seed: 1337, worldgenVersion, createdAt: 1, lastPlayedAt: 1 }]
39	          })
40	        );
41	      }
42	    }, WORLDGEN_VERSION);
43	
44	    await page.goto("/");
45	    // Enter the world through the menu (first load only; reloads auto-resume the tab's world).
46	    await page.getByTestId("profile-e2e-profile").click();
47	    await page.getByTestId("world-e2e-world").click();
48	    await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__monecraft !== undefined, undefined, { timeout: 30000 });
49	    // Wait for the first frames so the engine has stepped and the scene drew.
50	    await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__monecraft!.renderer.renderedTriangles() > 0, undefined, { timeout: 30000 });
51

60	/**
61	 * The game boots at dawn with aggro hostiles near the spawn; interactive
62	 * tests clear them and move to midday so knockback can't disrupt input.
63	 */
64	export async function calmDaytime(page: Page): Promise<void> {
65	  await page.evaluate(() => {
66	    const state = window.__monecraft!.engine.state;
67	    state.mobs = state.mobs.filter((mob) => !mob.hostile);
68	    state.dayClock = 60;
69	  });

72	export async function playerPosition(page: Page): Promise<{ x: number; y: number; z: number }> {
73	  return page.evaluate(() => {

75	    return { x: position.x, y: position.y, z: position.z };
76	  });
77	}

79	/**
80	 * Double-clicks the canvas to request pointer lock; if the browser refuses
81	 * (headless Chromium cannot engage pointer lock at all), forces the input
82	 * controller's lock flag so everything downstream — keys → engine, held mouse
83	 * → mining — is still exercised for real. The acquisition UX itself stays in
84	 * the manual gameplay pass.
85	 */
86	export async function acquirePointerLock(page: Page): Promise<void> {
87	  const canvas = page.locator(".game-canvas-wrap canvas");
88	  await canvas.dblclick();
89	  try {
90	    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.pointerLockElement !== null, undefined, { timeout: 2000 });
91	  } catch {
92	    await page.evaluate(() => {
93	      window.__monecraft!.input.forcePointerLock(true);
94	    });
95	  }
96	}
97	
98	export async function itemCount(page: Page, itemId: string): Promise<number> {
99	  return page.evaluate((id) => window.__monecraft!.engine.state.inventory.filter((slot) => slot.id === id).reduce((sum, slot) => sum + slot.count, 0), itemId);

1	"use client";
2	
3	import { createAuthClient } from "better-auth/react";
4	import { anonymousClient } from "better-auth/client/plugins";
5	
6	/**
7	 * Browser-side auth. Guests are created LAZILY — only when the player takes
8	 * an online action (sign-in panel, cloud sync, joining a world). Plain
9	 * offline single-player never calls any of this, so it stays account-free.
10	 *
11	 * The client itself constructs lazily too: better-auth validates the base
12	 * URL at construction, which must not run at import time (component tests
13	 * import menu modules under happy-dom, where no real origin exists).
14	 */
15	type Client = ReturnType<typeof createAuthClient<{ plugins: [ReturnType<typeof anonymousClient>] }>>;
16	
17	let instance: Client | null = null;
18	
19	export function authClient(): Client {
20	  instance ??= createAuthClient({
21	    baseURL: window.location.origin,
22	    plugins: [anonymousClient()]
23	  });
24	  return instance;
25	}
26	
27	export type OnlineUser = {
28	  id: string;
29	  name: string;
30	  email: string;
31	  isAnonymous: boolean;
32	};
33	
34	/**
35	 * "Has this browser ever used online features?" Offline-first hinges on it:
36	 * until the player takes an online action, the menu makes NO auth requests —
37	 * so a dev/e2e server without a database never even sees a session fetch.
38	 */
39	const ONLINE_USED_KEY = "minecraft_online_v1";
40	
41	export function onlineUsed(storage: Storage = localStorage): boolean {
42	  return storage.getItem(ONLINE_USED_KEY) === "1";
43	}
44	
45	export function markOnlineUsed(storage: Storage = localStorage): void {
46	  storage.setItem(ONLINE_USED_KEY, "1");
47	}
48	
49	/** The signed-in user (guest or full), or null. */
50	export async function currentUser(): Promise<OnlineUser | null> {
51	  const { data } = await authClient().getSession();
52	  if (!data?.user) return null;
53	  const user = data.user as { id: string; name: string; email: string; isAnonymous?: boolean | null };
54	  return { id: user.id, name: user.name, email: user.email, isAnonymous: user.isAnonymous === true };
55	}
56	
57	/** Ensures some identity exists — signs in anonymously on first online action. */
58	export async function ensureSignedIn(): Promise<OnlineUser | null> {
59	  markOnlineUsed();
60	  const existing = await currentUser();
61	  if (existing) return existing;
62	  const { error } = await authClient().signIn.anonymous();
63	  if (error) return null;
64	  return currentUser();
65	}
66
